title: Subtree complexity
blurb: Nine DOM and CSS workloads timed as plain DOM, a 2D drawable canvas and a WebGL canvas via ElementGL. Measures frame times, Long Animation Frames splits, changedElements invalidation counts and the effect of CSS containment on your device.
question: Which HTML and CSS features inside a drawable subtree cause disproportionate paint-record rebuilds or post-main-thread raster stalls, and does contain: layout paint or contain: strict reduce the cost?
